params.name: status
params.description:
Filter resources by status. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain the resources with the specified status.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort resources by field and direction. May be used multiple times.

For more information, see "[Sorting](#description/sorting)".

params.name: name
params.description:
Filter resources by their name.

The response will only contain the resources
matching exactly the specified name.

params.name: label_selector
params.description:
Filter resources by labels.

The response will only contain resources matching the label selector.
For more information, see "[Label Selector](#description/label-selector)".

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to return. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of entries returned per page. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

items.docs: Gets all existing Volumes that you have available.

Creates a new Volume attached to a Server. If you want to create a Volume that is not attached to a Server, you need to provide the `location` key instead of `server`. This can be either the ID or the name of the Location this Volume will be created in. Note that a Volume can be attached to a Server only in the same Location as the Volume itself.

Deletes a volume. All Volume data is irreversibly destroyed. The Volume must not be attached to a Server and it must not have delete protection enabled.
